# Glitch Mod

Glitch Mod is an exciting mod that introduces mysterious glitch-related elements to the Minecraft game, allowing players to find such interesting items, materials, and entities as never before.

## Features
**👾 Glitch Entity**

Meet Glitch Entity, a mysterious entity that has appeared in your world.

**⚔️ Glitch Sword**

Craft and use Glitch Sword, a useful item crafted of glitch-related materials.

**⛏️ Glitch Pickaxe**

Use Glitch Pickaxe for mining and collecting valuable resources in the game.

**🪨 Glitch Ore**

Find Glitch Ores located all around the world and craft glitch-related equipment.

**🎒 Glitch Backpack**

A backpack that you can put stuff into!

**🍎Glitch Apple**

A apple that when eatten gives strength and more health!

Supported Versions
Minecraft 1.21.8
Fabric Mod Loader
